user.title: Onkyo FlareConnect
user.description: Discovered devices are prefilled. Separate multiple addresses with a comma.

error.cannot_connect: None of the given addresses answered on eISCP.

join.name: Join
join.description: Creates a FlareConnect group. The command goes to the master, which drives the members itself.

source.name: Master
source.description: IP address or device id of the device providing the audio.

members.name: Members
members.description: IP addresses or device ids that follow the master.

group_id.name: Group number
group_id.description: Leave empty to pick one automatically.

max_delay.name: Maximum delay
max_delay.description: Audio delay in milliseconds; the app uses 5000.

unjoin.name: Unjoin
unjoin.description: Breaks up the group that the given device is the master of.

source.name: Master
source.description: IP address or device id of the group master.
